# Proofed

> Proofed is a managed proofreading and editing agency offering expert content quality assurance for businesses, students, and specialized industries.

Proofed provides comprehensive editing and proofreading services across multiple sectors including legal, financial, publishing, and marketing. The platform leverages a network of 750+ professional editors and offers specialized services for AI-generated content, eLearning materials, and grant proposals, with enterprise-grade security and confidentiality protections.
